facts.text: Patterned after the pre-war Bobover Yeshiva of Poland, the Talmudical Seminary of Bobov in Brooklyn offers rabbinical and Talmudic degrees accredited by AARTS.

sources.title: Talmudical Seminary of Bobov: Home
sources.quote: Talmudical Seminary of Bobov's First Talmudic Degree Program is accredited by the Association of Advanced Rabbinical and Talmudic Schools (AARTS).

sources.title: Talmudical Seminary of Bobov: Home
sources.quote: Talmudical Seminary of Bobov was founded in March 2005. It is patterned after the Bobover Yeshiva that existed in pre-war Poland. The Seminary caters primarily to Bobover Chassidic students but has a minority of non-Bobover Chassidic students as well.
